name: unreal-mcp (chongdashu)
summary: Experimental community project (UE plugin plus Python MCP server) letting Cursor, Windsurf or Claude Desktop control Unreal Engine actors and Blueprints.
description: Native TCP server plugin (UnrealMCP) with a sample project; targets UE 5.5+ and Python 3.12+. Self-described experimental and not recommended for production. The README shows an MIT badge, but the repo has no LICENSE file and GitHub reports no license, so license is left empty. Last commit 2025-04-22 (inactive, not marked deprecated).

agent_access.notes: Local Python server talking to an Unreal Editor plugin over TCP (port 55557).
